items.title: Real-time AI agents with Confluent Cloud and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Real-time AI agents that act on operational data need the current state of that data when they generate a response. An agent might approve a transaction, assess whether a patient is ready to go home, flag a machine for maintenance, or answer a question about an order that changed status a few seconds ago. Each […]
